svg.text: Real hourly wages by education level
Within-country change; each education group’s first observed year = 100
Real wage = nominal local-currency hourly wage ÷ CPI × 100 (2010-price local currency).
Each line is rebased separately: compare changes within a country, not wage levels across countries.
Source: SEDLAC (CEDLAS / World Bank), wage_1; World Bank WDI, FP.CPI.TOTL. Observed years only.
These education groups cover all sexes and ages in wage_1, unlike the prime-age male wage-gap figure.
Brazil’s PNAD expands to rural North in 2004; Mexico has no 1997 wage observation and no 2003–07 observations.
